question: Is the already-preregistered TIE-ROLE-FRONTIER-001 mechanism campaign worth spending approximately 8+ hours of T4x2 compute on?
decision_rule: This pilot must end with a binary RUN_FULL_TIE_ROLE or DO_NOT_RUN_FULL_TIE_ROLE decision. Ambiguous evidence is a NO-GO for the expensive campaign.

surface.development: same S5 development rows; identity is the primary scored family

model.architecture: TIE-ROLE exact frontier model: 8L/256w, V24576, tied embeddings, QK norm
model.optimizer: same canonical V5 AdamW and global clip

seeds.selection_rule: Both seeds are fresh relative to S5 and the prior baseline-gate diagnostic; neither is eligible to be substituted by a historical seed after outcomes are observed.

design.matched_pairs: T0 and T3 use the same seed and must be forward-equivalent at initialization; only backward gradient routing differs.

go_rule.name: RUN_FULL_TIE_ROLE
requires_all: both fresh seeds have T3 minus T0 formation-AUC delta >= 0.05
both fresh seeds have T3 minus T0 endpoint delta >= 0.10
neither seed has a negative endpoint delta
mean T0 and T3 endpoints are below 0.85, avoiding a ceiling regime
forward-equivalence preflight passes for both matched pairs
go_rule.reason: A two-seed pilot is being used only as a compute triage gate, so the effect threshold is deliberately stricter than the four-seed official frontier threshold.

no_go_rules.name: DO_NOT_RUN_FULL_TIE_ROLE
conditions: GO rule is not fully satisfied
either fresh seed shows a negative endpoint effect
either matched pair fails forward equivalence
both arms are too close to ceiling
no_go_rules.principle: Ambiguous or weak pilot evidence does not justify the expensive 24-arm frontier. Preserve the pilot and diagnose the next bottleneck with a smaller experiment.

claim_ceiling: The pilot can only decide whether the full TIE-ROLE frontier is worth its compute. It cannot establish the TIE-ROLE mechanism, alter S5, promote an architecture, or make cognition/AGI claims.
